title: feat(live-preview): show raw thematicBreak markdown when cursor is on the line

## Summary / 摘要

<!-- One sentence summary of the change. / 一句话说明改了什么。 -->
for thematic breack,  render source markdown when cursor on the line

## Motivation / 背景与动机

<!-- Why is this change needed? Link issue / roadmap entry / OpenSpec change. -->
<!-- 解决什么问题？关联 issue / roadmap 条目 / OpenSpec change id。 -->

If a user input `**|**` for blod text it will be renderer to thematic break rapidly even if the cursor still on the line.

Moreover, the slash-command  Bold will also input 4 asterisks which is rendered to thematic break brefore users can input any text.

It should show raw markdown souce text when cursor/selection on the line so user can edit or delete the source code. 


## Changes / 变更内容

<!-- List key changes per package. / 按包分节，列出关键改动点。 -->

- `packages/core`:
Add thematicBreak condition branch in buildDecorations to handle the display of source code.

Remove fallback code for block nodes(with only thematic breack)
